up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727538. Return the molecule ChEMBL identifier and preferred name for each molecule. Use the docs table to locate the document (chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727538'), then join through compound_records to molecule_dictionary. Ensure distinct molecules.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS preferred_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727538'
